entries.title: Psalms 141:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 141:2
segments: Let my prayer be set forth before thee [as] incense; [and] the lifting up of my hands [as] the evening sacrifice. {set...: Heb. directed}

entries.title: Psalms 141:3
segments: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 141:4
segments: Incline not my heart to [any] evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

entries.title: Psalms 141:5
segments: ¶Let the righteous smite me; [it shall be] a kindness: and let him reprove me; [it shall be] an excellent oil, [which] shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also [shall be] in their calamities. {me; it shall be a...: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break, etc}

words.text: . {me; it shall be a...: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 141:6
segments: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

entries.title: Psalms 141:7
segments: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth [wood] upon the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 141:8
segments: But mine eyes [are] unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute. {leave...: Heb. make not my soul bare}

words.text: . {leave...: Heb. make not my soul bare}

entries.title: Psalms 141:9
segments: Keep me from the snares [which] they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 141:10
segments: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape. {escape: Heb. pass over}
